entries.title: Vice City
entries.body: The main urban region of Leonida, with coastal neighborhoods, a downtown skyline and beaches.

entries.title: Leonida Keys
entries.body: A chain of subtropical islands and coastal communities south of the mainland.

entries.title: Grassrivers
entries.body: Wetlands and waterways with natural habitats, away from the main urban areas.

entries.title: Port Gellhorn
entries.body: A waterfront town on the western side of the state.

entries.title: Ambrosia
entries.body: An inland community associated with agriculture and industry.

entries.title: Mount Kalaga
entries.body: A northern national park, with hills, forest and outdoor scenery.

entries.title: Key Lento
entries.body: An island in the southern portion of the official tourism map, grid K6.

entries.title: Downtown Vice City
entries.body: A city district containing waterfront areas and the Dock Ring landmark.

entries.title: Washington Beach
entries.body: A Vice Beach district with several documented sculpture scans.

entries.title: Tequesta
entries.body: A Vice City district that includes the Pixel Fountain landmark.

entries.title: Belpoint
entries.body: A Mariana County community with a lighthouse landmark.

entries.title: Moreau
entries.body: A Lummox County community where historical ruins and a paper mill are documented.

entries.title: Corsair Key
entries.body: An island in Mariana County with a documented sculpture landmark.

entries.title: Manifest Canyon
entries.body: A Kelly County area with a documented orchard landmark.

entries.title: Jason Duval
entries.body: One of the two playable story protagonists, associated with the Leonida Keys.

entries.title: Lucia Caminos
entries.body: The second central protagonist. Her relationship with Jason shapes the story.

entries.title: Cal Hampton
entries.body: A friend of Jason whose interests include online theories and radio communications.

entries.title: Dre’Quan Priest
entries.body: An aspiring music executive associated with Only Raw Records.

entries.title: Real Dimez
entries.body: A music duo made up of Bae-Luxe and Roxy.

entries.title: Boobie Ike
entries.body: A Vice City business figure involved in real estate and music.

entries.title: Launch platforms
entries.body: Released on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

entries.title: Leonida
entries.body: The fictional state is the setting of GTA VI. Its environments span urban coastlines, islands, wetlands and inland regions.

entries.title: Official printable map
entries.body: Rockstar published a tourism-style Leonida poster at launch. Its printed grid can help identify broad regions; it is not a live game-position map.

entries.title: Game soundtrack
entries.body: Rockstar announced a launch album containing 34 original tracks.

entries.body: A launch guide reports 100 scans toward the completion checklist. Track discovered landmarks here and compare with the game's progress menu.

entries.title: Collectible cards
entries.body: One launch guide reports 18 sets, with 15 counting toward the completion goal. Totals may be revised.

entries.title: Underwater discoveries
entries.body: Launch guides list 33 underwater discoveries. This is a game collectible category, not a real-world activity guide.

news.title: GTA VI launches on consoles
news.summary: Rockstar announced worldwide availability for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. The launch also brought new official media, a printable map and a 34-track album.

news.title: Official Leonida map released
news.summary: The launch media collection includes a print-ready map of Leonida. VI Hub uses this source in its map viewer and keeps a local copy for later use.
